breaking.change: Loaded custom UI materials now attach explicitly to TSX primitives and composite their entire subtree after filters, before masks and opacity. Parameters are named finite scalars or vectors; unknown names, wrong widths and unloaded handles are refused.
breaking.fix: Pass material={{ shader: loaded.value, params: { progress } }} to View or another primitive. Omit params to follow tuned defaults; set material={undefined} to remove it. Loading alone still does not apply a finish.
